summary: Built a web application for Catholic Relief Services to manage the information contained in the PERSUAP document.
highlights: Built the React and TypeScript front end and the Express API behind it
Modelled the PERSUAP document data in SQL Server
Added search and editing screens so staff can keep the information up to date
Delivered the full stack, from database schema to UI

projects.name: PERSUAP manager
